children: Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. reported third-quarter fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $59.6M and diluted EPS of $0.31, driven by higher volumes in North America and MENA and improved profitability versus the year-ago quarter.
Revenue was $59.6M for Q3 FY2026, compared with $47.9M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 24.4%.
Net income attributable to common stock was $2.55M for Q3 FY2026, versus $0.85M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 199%.
Diluted earnings per share was $0.31 for Q3 FY2026, compared with $0.10 in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 210%.
Net sales grew year-over-year, with quarter-over-quarter strength: Q2 up 24% and year-to-date up 16%, driven by higher volumes in North America and MENA.
Regional mix shifted toward stronger volumes in North America and MENA; seasonal mix in Canada weighed on margins.
Gross margins remained consistent while ramp-up costs continued for the new Ohio manufacturing facility and Qatar projects.
Operational milestone: the new Ohio manufacturing start-up was commissioned and ramp activities contributed to higher sales volumes.
